profile.headline: Software Engineer at Ploutos | Web Development
profile.summary: Experienced software engineer with personal interest in Big Data and LLMs

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led the creation of an inventory management ERP SaaS platform with a small cross-functional team, built with Ruby on Rails and React.
• Invested heavily into tools (webpack/eslint/etc), testing (rspec/selenium/enzyme/jest), and workflows (CI/CD) to increase ease of use, developer experience and productivity as well as site reliability.
• Created a model change history system covering every model using JSONB, which allows for unstructured data storage and performant querying
• Implemented Elasticsearch for listing and custom filtering, allowing users to customize their UI, decreasing the time needed to complete an order
• Maintained an Opsworks AWS setup with CI/CD using github webhooks, semaphoreci, and aws cli to deploy
• Mentored junior engineers through pair programming and 1:1s to increase developer productivity and growth.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · JavaScript · React.js · Elasticsearch · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Responsible for the development and UX design of TaiwanYo's iOS app, a localized Yelp/Foursquare app for Taiwan, which started with ~30k MAU and doubled within 2 years to 60k MAU through successful deployment of features.
• Implemented new RESTful API features in Java along with their corresponding iOS features.
• Integrated FB SDK for Facebook sign in to share likes, reviews and check-ins, resulting in 4X increase in signups.
• Optimized mySQL query times for complicated queries, such as Popular and Trending Locations, increasing usage by lowering latency
• Integrated Solr
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Java · MySQL · Objective-C

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Wrote Java to import and aggregate data from various cellular network device logs into MYCOM's proprietary performance monitoring system
* Analyzed systems to determine root cause analysis for faults and anomalies

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
-Contributed in a start-up of under 10 employees, collectively designing and implementing solutions pertaining to the field of computer vision

-Designed, developed, and usability tested a custom UI, producing a skinned/branded UI using C++/CLI and WinForms. Utilized a combination of GDI, GDI+, and DirectX to achieve the desired usability and ease of development

-Designed and implemented a distributed database scheme using Microsoft SQL with the goal of attaining load balance and redundancy, which I later ported to MySQL for cost reasons

-Assumed the role of resident DBA, although my SQL skills were limited. Learned how to solve SQL problems on the fly while researching limitations and optimizations for implementation and performance

-Wrote various DirectShow filters using MSVC and COM, including custom transform filters, source filters, drawing/compositing filters, and streaming video filters

-Investigated and integrated many open source technologies including Boost, X264, and MySQL.

-Developed a webservice using ASP.NET to serve custom KMLs for display on GoogleEarth

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Prepared material and conducted small quiz section discussions, held office hours to tutor and address student questions, graded assignments, and attended meetings to coordinate with large lecture section.

positions.title: ITS Infrastructure and Development Intern
positions.description:
Developed projects and maintenance projects for internal customers based on Microsoft*s .NET framework 2.0 using C#, ASP.NET, and Microsoft SQL Server 2005 
Participated in the SDLC, taking part in writing technical designs, development, documentation for release, and post implementation reviews, while actively pursued Microsoft Certifications

positions.title: Java Client Framework Intern
positions.description:
Developed code in an internal framework team to build a framework that made use of abstracted framework, security and uniformity. 
Migrated a demo app from Eclipse framework to Java Client Framework, which was used to demonstrate requirements and to market the framework to internal clients. 
Implemented new Cerner SWT-based GUI components to be used in the framework.
